name: @gravito/quasar
description: Universal monitoring agent for Gravito Zenith with queue statistics (Probes) and real-time job tracking (Bridges)

scripts.test:coverage: bun test --timeout=10000 --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir coverage && bun run --bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.test:ci: bun test --timeout=10000 --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir coverage && bun run --bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.test:unit: test $(find src/__tests__ -name '*.test.ts' ! -path '*/integration/*' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -gt 0 && find src/__tests__ -name '*.test.ts' ! -path '*/integration/*' -print0 | xargs -0 bun test --timeout=10000 || echo 'No unit tests found'
scripts.test:integration: test $(find src/__tests__/integration -name '*.test.ts' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -gt 0 && find src/__tests__/integration -name '*.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 bun test --timeout=10000 || echo 'No integration tests found'
